text: SPoS binds validator votes irrevocably by requiring commitment via hash preimages that are revealed only after a designated period, driving the probability of successful post-facto vote alteration below 2^-128.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5225296

abstract: These schemes require validators to commit to votes via hash preimages, revealed only after a designated period, rendering post-facto alterations computationally infeasible with a probability of success below 2^-128
